    Information

    [edit]
    • Mauga is banned during the Playoffs

    Format

    [edit]
    • Knockout Stage: December 4th - December 5th
      • Single elimination Bracket
      • All matches are Ft2
      • Four teams advance to the Playoffs.
    • Playoffs: December 6th - December 7th
      • Double elimination Bracket.
      • All matches (excl. Grand Finals) are Ft3
      • Grand Finals are Ft4
